_note: Deploy values only. Program id comes from the IDL (target/idl/safu_pool.json `address`); every rule number comes from the IDL constants. `usdcMint`: Circle's USDC on this cluster (classic SPL Token, 6 decimals; `initialize` refuses anything else). `poolCapUsdc`: USDC base units, same cap as the Stellar pool ($100,000). `siteRpcPath`: the deployed site reads the chain through the claim API (/rpc, server-side provider failover); `rpcUrl` is for tools and local dev.
